source: Owner takeover package (00_唯一执行任务.md) sections 3-6, the structural rework Markdown, and the independent read-only reviewer findings D1-D11

checks.V01: Auxiliary labels occupy independent horizontal rows
checks.V02: Feedback icon, content, status and action align with the header
checks.V03: Feedback has its own copy and no upload CTA
checks.V04: Feedback content search uses the bounded server query when the candidate supports it; a pre-interface candidate keeps one honest limitation and never filters client-side
checks.V05: Existing disclosure keyboard flow and absence of native marker
checks.V06: Identical feedback geometry in all tested navigation orders

V07.defect: Shared drawer a11y sync wrote one label into every open .ant-drawer.
V07.fix: Per-instance root class naming; each open instance keeps its own aria-label/aria-labelledby; only the top layer is aria-modal, covered layers inert; per-instance focus restore and Escape layering.
V07.evidence: qa/final-check.mjs drawer-single / drawer-stacked-names / drawer-stack-modal / drawer-close-top / drawer-focus-after-close / drawer-close-all / drawer-reopen-order / drawer-route-leave

V08.defect: P05 at 320x500 stacked title, download/full-screen card, file header and PDF controls so the paper page fell out of the short first screen.
V08.fix: Identity, page/zoom and download/full-screen reorganized into one compact reader toolbar; the real PDF page starts in the first screen; real render/fit/zoom/paging/download/full-screen and desktop 650px two-column kept.

V09.defect: P08 versions page stacked capability note, statistics, refresh, server search, local search and department filter before the list; first row ~260px late.
V09.fix: One primary toolbar with a single prototype-aligned search control; secondary 更多筛选 disclosure (department, refresh, projection detail); lineage moved to a collapsed section under the list; phones not later than prototype +24px; desktop difference recorded (see differences).

V10.defect: P04 records used a two-row large-button toolbar instead of the prototype's compact tabs + refresh row.
V10.fix: Compact tab group + feedback link + icon refresh in one row, count caption, text action on desktop / icon on phones, on-demand pagination; refresh, delete and continue-reading kept.

V11.defect: P06/P07 main card about 50px late at 320px due to a shared page header carrying an English eyebrow and 14px description.
V11.fix: Non-Q&A pages hide the English eyebrow; prototype mobile type scale wins over the older query-page override; positions re-measured.

D1.defect: Drawer top layer was decided by DOM order; a drawer whose portal mounted later could cover a newer one and be marked inert.
D1.fix: Explicit monotonic open order in drawerDialogA11y.ts; open order is set on first open, forgotten on close/reopen; top layer chosen by order, not DOM. Covered layers inert.
D1.evidence: qa/final-check.mjs drawer-stacked-names / drawer-reopen-order / drawer-cross-component-stack (portal order inversion simulated by separate components). The reviewer's manage-bulk portal-inversion path is not reproducible in the synthetic preview without fake service state; covered by the explicit-order implementation.

D2.defect: Evidence drawer + feedback drawer could both be aria-modal=true with no inert when stacked across components.
D2.fix: Shared layer manager used by EvidenceDrawer, KnowledgeConnections, KnowledgeTools feedback drawer and all maintenance drawers; open/close re-ranks the whole knowledge drawer stack.

D3.defect: Preview fixture fabricated a fixed version lineage for every state while the UI claimed server lineage.
D3.fix: Lineage chain is served only by ?state=visual (explicitly synthetic); the default preview returns an honest unavailable state; inherited 'live' comments corrected to candidate contract without claiming real-service verification.

D4.defect: P08 toolbar had two search triggers (input-search plus a separate 查找 button) and default Ant appearance.
D4.fix: Single custom searchbox styled per the v1.7 toolbar with one submit trigger; secondary controls moved behind 更多筛选.

D5.defect: Local title/department filter silently no-op while a server lookup result was shown.
D5.fix: visibleDocs applies the typed term and department filter to lookup rows as well as the loaded list.

D6.defect: P08 desktop first row can be earlier than the prototype; a 2px anchor cannot be met across the reorganized toolbar.
D6.fix: Phones assert a late bound (+24px) and pass (+18 / -8); desktop deviation is emitted as DIFFERENCE_RECORDED with delta and cause in v17-final-result.json instead of an invented PASS tolerance.

D7.defect: Drawer focus-restore timers were not cleaned up and stale focus targets could be reused.
D7.fix: All drawer timers go through a registered set cleared on route change/unmount; the focus target is consumed on close and the map entry cleared immediately.

D8.defect: P04 row primary action was icon-only on desktop while the prototype keeps a text action.
D8.fix: Text action (继续查阅 / 查看资料) on >=768px with a 100px target; icon-only on phones.

D9.defect: Mobile page-head size overrides were dead because an older higher-specificity query-page rule won.
D9.fix: Matching-specificity overrides at the end of knowledge.css for <=600 and <=380.
D9.evidence: src/styles/knowledge.css final overrides; geometry measured by qa/final-check.mjs

D10.defect: P08 phone row action wrapped below the main text and left-aligned.
D10.fix: Phone row is a 3-column grid (icon / main / action) with the action right-aligned.

D11.defect: Acceptance evidence was not bound to the final SHA.
D11.fix: qa/final-check.mjs reads git rev-parse HEAD and git status --porcelain and writes finalSha/worktreeDirty into v17-final-result.json; the final run is executed on the clean delivered commit.

P09_SEARCH_INTERFACE.defect: P09 had no content search (live get_feedback_queue without query returned INVALID_REQUEST for a query parameter).
P09_SEARCH_INTERFACE.fix: Main implemented a bounded read-only feedback_queue(query=) filter in the isolated tree; B wired getMaintenanceFeedbackPage(page,status,query), the enabled search box, status+query filtering and an honest INVALID_REQUEST fallback. Evidence: fixture adds the same bounded query contract plus ?state=feedback-no-search; unit tests cover supported and fallback paths; final-check p09-server-search-supported / p09-server-search-filters / p09-unsupported-fallback.
P09_SEARCH_INTERFACE.note: Real search becomes observable only after release #2 pairs the new frontend with the patched BFF; until then the released candidate keeps the limitation line.

capability_gaps.P09_content_search: CAPABILITY_GAP — the service contract has no feedback content search; the control stays disabled with one honest limitation line.
capability_gaps.P08_version_lineage: Candidate contract GET get_version_lineage (inherited W1 commit). Browser-verified against the synthetic visual scene only; the real service availability was not verified in this workspace and is reported as an integration dependency, not as production-verified.

not_verified: Physical devices, Safari/Firefox, full screen readers, system Chinese IME on a real OS.
P05 fullscreen re-checked only in isolated headless Chrome with real mouse gestures, not on a physical display.

The reviewer's bulk-drawer portal inversion could not be driven from the synthetic preview (no selectable quality rows); D1 is covered by the explicit open-order implementation and the reopen/cross-component regressions.
